title: Catalog pricing matrix + deprecation banners — screenshot & quickstart visual pack for release notes
creator: Ava Chen
description: Produce a focused set of UX assets and high-fidelity screenshots for the Feb catalog release notes: primary deliverables are a pricing matrix visualization (desktop + mobile + dark mode), model variant rows (standard/quantized/fast), deprecation banners and the migration quickstart modal. These will be used in the public release notes, the Console release banner, and the onboarding quickstart flow that surfaces newly added or deprecated models. The designs must be consistent with the refreshed catalog visual language and include explicit cost/tooling callouts (per-token and estimated hour cost), region availability badges, and an accessible deprecation CTA flow.
acceptance_criteria: High-res PNG and SVG exports for all requested screens (desktop/mobile/dark)
Screenshots that match the production Console markup (font size, spacing within 8px grid)
Deprecation banner states: initial, acknowledged, migration-in-progress, migrated-successfully
Pricing matrix shows per-model tier rows and an expanded row with cost breakdown tooltip
Quickstart modal includes copy doc link, migration checklist, and CTA to create a migration ticket
All assets uploaded to Drive + links included in ticket; review sign-off from PM and Engineering
tasks: Audit current catalog components and extract live markup refs (Console repo)
Create wireframes for pricing matrix + deprecation banner states
Design high-fidelity comps (desktop, mobile, dark) and export assets
Capture production-like screenshots using storybook/Console staging env
Prepare copy variants for release notes and quickstart microcopy
Collect engineering feedback and finalize exports
Upload assets to Drive and add links to release PR
screenshots_to_capture: Catalog: pricing matrix overview (desktop, full-width) with hover cost tooltip open
Catalog: model row expanded showing variant selector (standard / quantized / fast) and per-token rates
Catalog: per-model info card with region availability badges (us-west, eu-central, apac) and capability icons
Deprecation: inline banner (yellow) with 'Deprecated' label and learn-more link
Deprecation: CTA modal for migration (migration checklist + estimated cost impact)
Deprecation: post-migration success toast and updated model-status chip
Quickstart: onboarding snack showing 'New model available' with one-click 'Try in Playground'
Console: release notes hero with delta badge 'New models + deprecations' and link to screenshots
Mobile: condensed pricing row and deprecation banner in narrow viewport (iOS & Android)
Dark mode: pricing matrix and deprecation banner color treatments
